about: The World University Service (W.U.S.) Health Centre is a premier health scheme pioneered at the University of Delhi in 1955. Over nearly seven decades, the network has grown to include four key medical units distributed strategically across Delhi to ensure swift medical accessibility. The nodal facility operates from the North Campus, while specialized auxiliary units are functional in the South Campus, East Delhi, and West Delhi regions.
nodalOperations: The North Campus Nodal Centre provides primary healthcare services 24 hours a day, 7 days a week (excluding public holidays and Sundays, when standard OPD operations are suspended but emergency support remains accessible).

staffEligibility: Enrollment is mandatory for all permanent University employees residing within an 8 kilometer radius of the North or South Campus Health Centres. Wholly dependent parents, unmarried sisters, minor brothers, widowed daughters, unemployed daughters/sons (under conditions) are covered.

benefits: Outpatient Department (OPD) Consultations: Daily OPD access with general duty medical officers across all units.
Specialist Referral and Care: Access to visiting specialists including dentists, dermatologists, psychiatrists, eye specialists, and sports physiotherapists.
Free Basic Medicines: Supply of essential acute drugs (3-5 days) and chronic medications (up to 30 days) under medical supervision.
Diagnostic Support: Subsidized or nil rates for basic blood, urine, and stool testing at campus labs.
Mental Health Support: Face-to-face appointments and hotlines with licensed counselors and psychologists.
